responsibility: Provides the core language-independent implementation of GCC’s tree node subsystem. It owns low-level allocation and interning for identifiers, integer/poly-integer constants, and uniqued types; maintains global tables describing tree codes and tree-node kinds; constructs and canonicalizes declarations, types, expressions, blocks, location wrappers, and option nodes; supplies numerous generic predicates, folding-adjacent builders, attribute and builtin helpers, warning/location utilities, and selftests; and serves as the main implementation companion to tree.h for the fundamental GENERIC/tree IR data model used throughout the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Core implementation file for GCC's tree subsystem: it defines storage, interning, constructors, predicates, tables, and other executable support routines for tree nodes. Unlike tree.h, which declares the public interface, and tree.def, which lists the tree-code definitions, this file provides the compiled behavior behind them.
